Istria · Signature seven-day journey

Istria Signature Journey — a private curated journey

From €5,190 per person

Istria Signature Journey gives the peninsula its full week — two accommodation bases so nothing is rushed, two private days on the Adriatic, and a route that runs from Pula's Roman stone to the truffle oak of the interior. It is the complete version of the Istria story: coast, hill towns, wine country and the sea, worked into a single unhurried arc.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Pula & Rovinj

    A private transfer meets you in Pula for an unhurried first look at the Arena and the old town, before continuing to Rovinj — the first of two accommodation bases. An easy waterfront ride is on offer for those who want it, then a long welcome dinner.

  2. Day 2

    The west coast by bike

    E-MTBs trace the coast from Rovinj through Zlatni Rt and the Limski Canal to Bale and the ruins at Dvigrad, vehicle support shadowing the whole route. Lunch and a winery visit close the day at a proper Istrian pace.

  3. Day 3

    Brijuni by boat

    A private speedboat opens the Brijuni archipelago and the Fažana Channel — swimming, quiet coves, an unhurried lunch on the water, with a curated olive oil tasting folded into the afternoon.

  4. Day 4

    Into central Istria

    The journey turns inland: a signature ride through Grožnjan's artist lanes and the old Parenzana railway toward Motovun, where your second base — deeper in wine country — waits above the hill towns.

  5. Day 5

    Truffles, Hum & Buzet

    A morning truffle hunt with a family of hunters and their dogs, then the smallest town in the world at Hum, the Butoniga lake, and Buzet's old walls, closing at a family winery.

  6. Day 6

    The Adriatic again

    A second private boat day, this time the Rovinj archipelago and Lim Bay — a different stretch of coast, the same unhurried logic, with a sunset run back to the mainland if conditions allow.

  7. Day 7

    Poreč & departure

    A last morning at the Euphrasian Basilica and Poreč's old town before your private transfer to the airport of your choice.

Questions

+ Is the Istria Signature Journey private?

Yes — every Adrion journey runs exclusively for your party, arranged around your dates and pace.

+ Is previous cycling experience required?

No — the E-MTB days suit a general level of fitness, with vehicle support and flexible route planning throughout.

+ Why two accommodation bases instead of one?

It reduces daily travel and lets you experience both the western coastline and inland Istria properly, rather than rushing between them.

+ Can this journey be extended?

Yes — it combines naturally with a Kvarner extension or another Adrion journey.
